verdict.headline: Almagreira Lunch
verdict.reason: Almagreira is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should help keep it tidy.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.

conversationalSummary.text: Alright Pedro, for TODAY at Almagreira around lunch it’s the best bet, but I’m treating it as a check-first kind of day. I’d watch Surfline and MEO Beachcam before leaving because the Surfline consistency is a bit hit-and-miss, and you want to avoid it being underpowered or getting messy. The wind looks decent and tide is mid rising, which should help, but it’s still a pretty wind-exposed beach break. Check the cams—if they don’t look clearly better than expected, probably skip.
